#if (LIGHTING_STAGE == LIGHTING_PHONG)
iNliNE half3 phongSpecularStage()
{
	#if defined(PRELIGHT_FX) && !defined(PRELIGHT_FX_LIVE_SPECULAR)
		// Prelit phong specular effect
		#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_layer0_color)	
		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, specular_params)
		#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_incident)
		#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_normal)

		#if defined(PRELIGHT_FX_EDITOR_SPECULAR)
			// Use light 0 for the specular direction.
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_specularDirection)
			half3 refl = reflect(-fs_specularDirection.xyz, fs_normal);
		#else
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_lightDirSet)
			half3 refl = reflect(-fs_lightDirSet, fs_normal);
		#endif
		half3 prelitPhong = fs_layer0_color.rgb * pow(max(0, dot(fs_incident, refl)), specular_params.r);
		#if defined(REFRACTION_STAGE)
			return prelitPhong * specular_params.g * fs_layer0_color.a;
		#else
			return prelitPhong * specular_params.g;
		#endif
	#endif

	#if LIGHTING_LIGHTS_COUNT <= 0
		// there are no lights
		return half3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);		
	#endif 
	
	// phong specular
	#if (PIXEL_SHADER_VERSION == 11)
		// pixel shader 1.1 - simulate the specular effect using the phong environment texture
		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, averageLightColor)
		#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_worldReflectionRot)
		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, envmap_samplerCube)
		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, specular_params)
		half4 envTexel = texCUBE(envmap_samplerCube, varying_worldReflectionRot);
		return envTexel.rgb * specular_params.g * averageLightColor;
				
	#else
		#if (PIXEL_SHADER_VERSION == 20)
			// pixel shader 2.0 - compute the specular effect using the average live light direction and colour
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, averageLightColor)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, averageLightDir)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, specular_params)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_incident)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_normal)
			half3 R2 = reflect(-averageLightDir.xyz, fs_normal);
			half3 specularPhong = averageLightColor.rgb * pow(max(0, dot(fs_incident, R2)), specular_params.r);
		#else
			// pixel shader 2.0a upwards - compute the specular effect using up to 3 live lights
			half3 specularPhong;
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, specular_params)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, lightColor0)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_lightDir0)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_incident)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_normal)
			half3 R0 = reflect(-fs_lightDir0.xyz, fs_normal);
			specularPhong = lightColor0.rgb * pow(max(0, dot(fs_incident, R0)), specular_params.r) * lightColor0.a;
			#if (LIGHTING_LIGHTS_COUNT > 1)
				#pragma nu2_use(uniform, lightColor1)
				#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_lightDir1)
				half3 R1 = reflect(-fs_lightDir1.xyz, fs_normal);
				specularPhong += lightColor1.rgb * pow(max(0, dot(fs_incident, R1)), specular_params.r) * lightColor1.a;
			#endif
			#if (LIGHTING_LIGHTS_COUNT > 2)
				#pragma nu2_use(uniform, lightColor2)
				#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_lightDir2)
				half3 R2 = reflect(-fs_lightDir2.xyz, fs_normal);
				specularPhong += lightColor2.rgb * pow(max(0, dot(fs_incident, R2)), specular_params.r) * lightColor2.a;
			#endif
		#endif

		// For prelit materials we darken the specular effect by the underlying diffuse lighting intensity.
		#if defined(PRELIGHT_FX) && (PIXEL_SHADER_VERSION > 11) && defined(PRELIGHT_FX_LIVE_SPECULAR)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_prelitSpecularFactor)
			specularPhong *= fs_prelitSpecularFactor;
		#endif
		
		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, specular_params)
		#if defined(REFRACTION_STAGE)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_layer0_color)
			return specularPhong * specular_params.g * fs_layer0_color.a;
		#else
			return specularPhong * specular_params.g;
		#endif		
	#endif	
}

//__________________________________________________________________________________________________
#endif

iNliNE void lightingStage( out half3 diffuseLight, out half3 specularLight )
{
	diffuseLight  = half3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
	specularLight = half3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);

	#if (PIXEL_SHADER_VERSION == 11)
		
		#if (LIGHTMAP_STAGE == LIGHTMAP_SMOOTH)
			#pragma nu2_use(varying, * LIGHTMAP_UVSET)
			diffuseLight = tex2D(lightmap0, LIGHTMAP_UVSET).rgb;			
		#else
			// No lighting contribution
			diffuseLight = half3(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
		#endif

		#if (LIGHTING_STAGE != DISABLE)
			#if defined(SURFACE_UVSET)
				// Hacky shader 1.1 bumpmapping assuming lighting from above.
				#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_surfaceNormal)
				diffuseLight += (1.0 + 1.414 * fs_surfaceNormal.y);	
			#endif
		#endif
	#else
		#if (LIGHTMAP_STAGE == DISABLE)
			#if (LIGHTING_STAGE == DISABLE)
				// No lighting contribution
				diffuseLight = half3(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
			#endif
			#if defined(PRELIGHT_FX) && defined(PRELIGHT_FX_LIVE_SPECULAR)
				#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_layer0_color)
				#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_prelitSpecularFactor)
				fs_prelitSpecularFactor = 0.30 * fs_layer0_color.r + 0.59 * fs_layer0_color.g + 0.11 * fs_layer0_color.b;
			#endif
		#elif (LIGHTMAP_STAGE == LIGHTMAP_SMOOTH)
			#pragma nu2_use(varying, * LIGHTMAP_UVSET)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_prelitSpecularFactor)
			half3 lightmapCol = tex2D(lightmap0, LIGHTMAP_UVSET).rgb;
			#if defined(PRELIGHT_FX) && defined(PRELIGHT_FX_LIVE_SPECULAR)
				fs_prelitSpecularFactor = 0.30 * lightmapCol.r + 0.59 * lightmapCol.g + 0.11 * lightmapCol.b;
			#endif
			diffuseLight = lightmapCol;
		#elif (LIGHTMAP_STAGE == LIGHTMAP_DIRECTIONAL)
			#pragma nu2_use(varying, * LIGHTMAP_UVSET)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_surfaceNormal)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_prelitSpecularFactor)
			float3 weights;
			weights.x = dot(fs_surfaceNormal,float3(	-0.4082482904,	-0.7071067811,	0.5773502691));
			weights.y = dot(fs_surfaceNormal,float3(	-0.4082482904,	0.7071067811,	0.5773502691));
			weights.z = dot(fs_surfaceNormal,float3(	0.8164965809,	0.0,			0.5773502691));
			weights = max( weights, 0.0 );
			float4 lmcol1 = tex2D(lightmap0, LIGHTMAP_UVSET).rgba;
			float3 lmcol2 = tex2D(lightmap1, LIGHTMAP_UVSET).rgb;
			float3 lmcol3 = tex2D(lightmap2, LIGHTMAP_UVSET).rgb;
			half3 lightmapCol = lmcol1.rgb * weights.x + lmcol2.rgb * weights.y + lmcol3.rgb * weights.z;
			//half LightmapGlow = lmcol1.a;
			#if defined(PRELIGHT_FX) && defined(PRELIGHT_FX_LIVE_SPECULAR)
				fs_prelitSpecularFactor = 0.30 * lightmapCol.r + 0.59 * lightmapCol.g + 0.11 * lightmapCol.b;
			#endif
			diffuseLight = lightmapCol;
			if (LIGHTMAP_UVSET.x <= 0.0)
			{
				// Vertex-lit case.
				//LightmapGlow = 0;
				diffuseLight = half3(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
				#if defined(PRELIGHT_FX) && defined(PRELIGHT_FX_LIVE_SPECULAR)
					#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_layer0_color)
					fs_prelitSpecularFactor = 0.30 * fs_layer0_color.r + 0.59 * fs_layer0_color.g + 0.11 * fs_layer0_color.b;
				#endif
			}
			// Lightmap HDR glow factor
			//fout.color[1].a -= LightmapGlow;
		#endif
		
		#if (LIGHTING_STAGE == LIGHTING_LAMBERT) || (LIGHTING_STAGE == LIGHTING_PHONG) || (LIGHTING_STAGE == LIGHTING_WARD)
			
			#if defined(PRELIGHT_FX)
				#if (LIGHTMAP_STAGE == DISABLE)
					diffuseLight = half3(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
				#endif
			#else
				#if LIGHTING_LIGHTS_COUNT > 0
					// lightDirX are potentially point lights
					#pragma nu2_use(uniform, lightColor0)
					#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_ldotn0)
					diffuseLight += fs_ldotn0 * lightColor0.rgb;
				#endif
				#if LIGHTING_LIGHTS_COUNT > 1
					#pragma nu2_use(uniform, lightColor1)
					#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_ldotn1)
					diffuseLight += fs_ldotn1 * lightColor1.rgb;
				#endif
				#if LIGHTING_LIGHTS_COUNT > 2
					#pragma nu2_use(uniform, lightColor2)
					#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_ldotn2)
					diffuseLight += fs_ldotn2 * lightColor2.rgb;
				#endif
			#endif
		#endif
					
		#if (LIGHTING_STAGE == LIGHTING_PHONG)
			specularLight += phongSpecularStage();
		#endif
		
		#if (LIGHTING_STAGE == LIGHTING_WARD)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, specular_params)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, lightColor0)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_lightDir0)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_incident)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_normal)		
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_tangent)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_bitangent)	
			
			half3 Hn = normalize( fs_incident + fs_lightDir0.xyz );
			half a = 0.3;
			half b = 0.1;
			half s = 0.8;
			half2 ab = half2(1/a,1/b);
			half2 top = half2( dot(Hn,fs_tangent), dot(Hn,fs_bitangent) );
			top = top * ab;
			half bottom = dot(Hn,fs_normal);
			half power = dot(top,top) / (bottom*bottom);
			half spec = (s / (4*3.142)) * (1/(a*b)) * pow( 2.718, -power );
			specularLight += lightColor0.rgb * specular_params.g * spec * lightColor0.a;		
		#endif
		
		#if (LIGHTING_STAGE == LIGHTING_ENVMAP)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, fs_viewInverseTranspose)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, diffenvmap_samplerCube)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_nativeNormal)
			half3 worldNormal = mul((float3x3)fs_viewInverseTranspose, fs_nativeNormal.xyz);
			half3 diffuseEnvLight = texCUBE(diffenvmap_samplerCube, worldNormal );
			diffuseLight += diffuseEnvLight * 2.5; // Scaled up as textures are clamped to 0-1 range
		#endif
			
		#if (LIGHTING_STAGE == LIGHTING_KAJIYAKAY)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_lightDir0)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, lightColor0)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_incident)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_normal)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_tangent)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, specular_params)
			
			half ldott = dot(fs_lightDir0.xyz, fs_tangent);
			half kajiyaKayDiffuse = clamp( sqrt(1.0-ldott*ldott), 0.0, 1.0);
			half phongDiffuse = clamp( dot(fs_lightDir0.xyz, fs_normal), 0.0, 1.0f);
			half diffuse = kajiyaKayDiffuse * 0.5 + phongDiffuse * 0.5;
			diffuseLight = lightColor0 * diffuse * fs_lightDir0.w;			
			half3 Hn = normalize( fs_lightDir0.xyz + fs_incident );
			half hdott = dot(Hn,fs_tangent);
			half specular = clamp( pow( sqrt( 1.0 - hdott*hdott ), specular_params.r * 10 ), 0.0, 1.0);
			specularLight += lightColor0.rgb * specular_params.g * specular * clamp( dot( fs_normal, fs_lightDir0.xyz ) * 30, 0.0, 1.0 ) * lightColor0.a; // Remove back facing specular
		#endif
		
		#if (LIGHTING_STAGE == LIGHTING_ANISO)
		
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_normal)		
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_incident)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, specular_params)
			#if defined(ANISO_FLIP)
				#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_tangent)
				half3 anisoBasis = cross(fs_tangent, fs_normal);
			#else
				#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_bitangent)
				half3 anisoBasis = cross(fs_bitangent, fs_normal);
			#endif
			half vdotb = dot(fs_incident, anisoBasis);
			half vbf = sqrt(1.0 - (vdotb * vdotb));
			half base;

			#if defined(PRELIGHT_FX) && !defined(PRELIGHT_FX_LIVE_SPECULAR)
				#if (LIGHTMAP_STAGE == DISABLE)
					diffuseLight = half3(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
				#endif
				#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_layer0_color)	
				#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_nativeNormal)
				
				#if defined(PRELIGHT_FX_EDITOR_SPECULAR)
					// Use light 0 for the specular direction.
					#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_specularDirection)
					half ldotb = dot(fs_specularDirection.xyz, anisoBasis);
				#else
					#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_lightDirSet)
					half ldotb = dot(fs_lightDirSet.xyz, anisoBasis);
				#endif
				half ldotn = max(0.0, dot(fs_lightDirSet.xyz, fs_normal));
				half ad = sqrt(1.0 - ldotb * ldotb);
				base = max(0.0, ad * vbf - (ldotb * vdotb));
				specularLight = ldotn * fs_layer0_color.rgb * specular_params.g * pow(base, specular_params.r);
			#else
			
				#if LIGHTING_LIGHTS_COUNT > 0
					#pragma nu2_use(uniform, lightColor0)
					#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_lightDir0)
					#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_ldotn0)
					half ldotb0, ad0;
					ldotb0 = dot(fs_lightDir0.xyz, anisoBasis);
					ad0 = sqrt(1.0 - ldotb0 * ldotb0);
					diffuseLight += lightColor0 * ad0 * fs_ldotn0;
				#endif
				#if LIGHTING_LIGHTS_COUNT > 1
					#pragma nu2_use(uniform, lightColor1)
					#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_lightDir1)
					#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_ldotn1)
					half ldotb1, ad1;
					ldotb1 = dot(fs_lightDir1.xyz, anisoBasis);
					ad1 = sqrt(1.0 - ldotb1 * ldotb1);
					diffuseLight += lightColor1 * ad1 * fs_ldotn1;
				#endif
				#if LIGHTING_LIGHTS_COUNT > 2
					#pragma nu2_use(uniform, lightColor2)
					#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_lightDir2)
					#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_ldotn2)
					half ldotb2, ad2;
					ldotb2 = dot(fs_lightDir2.xyz, anisoBasis);
					ad2 = sqrt(1.0 - ldotb2 * ldotb2);
					diffuseLight += lightColor2 * ad2 * fs_ldotn2;
				#endif
				
				specularLight = half3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
				#if LIGHTING_LIGHTS_COUNT > 0
					#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_ldotn0)
					base = max(0.0, ad0 * vbf - (ldotb0 * vdotb));
					specularLight += fs_ldotn0 * lightColor0.rgb * specular_params.g * pow(base, specular_params.r) * lightColor0.a;
				#endif
				#if LIGHTING_LIGHTS_COUNT > 1
					#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_ldotn1)
					base = max(0.0, ad1 * vbf - (ldotb1 * vdotb));
					specularLight += fs_ldotn1 * lightColor1.rgb * specular_params.g * pow(base, specular_params.r) * lightColor1.a;
				#endif
				#if LIGHTING_LIGHTS_COUNT > 2
					#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_ldotn2)
					base = max(0.0, ad2 * vbf - (ldotb2 * vdotb));
					specularLight += fs_ldotn2 * lightColor2.rgb * specular_params.g * pow(base, specular_params.r) * lightColor2.a;
				#endif
				
				// For prelit materials we darken the specular effect by the underlying diffuse lighting intensity.
				#if defined(PRELIGHT_FX) && (PIXEL_SHADER_VERSION > 11) && defined(PRELIGHT_FX_LIVE_SPECULAR)
					#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_prelitSpecularFactor)
					specularLight *= fs_prelitSpecularFactor;
				#endif

			#endif

		#endif 
								
		#if (LIGHTING_STAGE == LIGHTING_GOOCH)
			specularLight = 0;
			diffuseLight = half3(0,1,0);
			#if LIGHTING_LIGHTS_COUNT > 0
				#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_lightDir0)
				#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_incident)
				#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_normal)
				#pragma nu2_use(uniform, gooch_params)
				half ndotl_norm = dot( fs_lightDir0.xyz, fs_normal ) * 0.5 + 0.5;
				half rimFactor = dot( fs_incident, fs_normal ) * (1-gooch_params.g) / gooch_params.r + gooch_params.g;
				rimFactor = clamp( rimFactor, 1.0, gooch_params.g );		
				// Output amount of 'diffuse' in red channel and amount of 'ambient'
				// in green channel, to be blended later in refractionStage()
				diffuseLight.r = ndotl_norm * rimFactor;
				diffuseLight.g = (1-ndotl_norm) * rimFactor;
				diffuseLight.b = 0;
			#endif
		#endif		
	#endif
	
	#if defined(EDGE_LIGHTING)
		// edgelit_params (r,g,b,a) = (width, boost, cut, specular).
		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, edgelit_params)
		#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_normal)
		#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_incident)
		half3 edgeSpecular;
		half edgeLightBlend = pow(1.0 + min(0.0, -dot(fs_normal, fs_incident)), edgelit_params.r);
		half edgeLightRange = edgelit_params.g - edgelit_params.b;
		diffuseLight = diffuseLight * (1.0 - (edgelit_params.b * (1.0 - edgeLightBlend)) + (edgeLightRange * edgeLightBlend));
		#if LIGHTING_LIGHTS_COUNT > 0
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, lightColor0)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_ldotn0)
			edgeSpecular  = pow(fs_ldotn0, 8.0) * lightColor0;
		#endif
		#if LIGHTING_LIGHTS_COUNT > 1
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, lightColor1)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_ldotn1)
			edgeSpecular += pow(fs_ldotn1, 8.0) * lightColor1;
		#endif
		#if LIGHTING_LIGHTS_COUNT > 2
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, lightColor2)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_ldotn2)
			edgeSpecular += pow(fs_ldotn2, 8.0) * lightColor2;
		#endif
		specularLight += (edgeSpecular * edgeLightBlend * edgelit_params.a * edgelit_params.g);
	#endif

	#if !defined(PRELIGHT_FX)
	#if LIGHTING_STAGE != DISABLE && PIXEL_SHADER_VERSION != 11
		// Apply any ambient and glow to all active diffuse lighting models.
		#if (LIGHTING_STAGE != LIGHTING_GOOCH)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, sceneAmbientColor)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, ambientColor)
			diffuseLight += ambientColor.rgb + sceneAmbientColor.rgb;
		#endif
		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, incandescentGlow)
		diffuseLight = lerp(diffuseLight, half3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0), incandescentGlow.rgb);
	#endif
	#endif
}

//__________________________________________________________________________________________________

iNliNE half4 surfaceShadingStage(const in half4 surfaceColor,
								 const in half3 diffuseLight,
								 const in half3 specularLight,
								 const in half fresnel,
								 const in half refractMod)
{
	#if !defined(REFRACTION_STAGE)
		#if (LIGHTMAP_STAGE != DISABLE)
			#if defined(PRELIGHT_FX) && (LIGHTMAP_STAGE == LIGHTMAP_SMOOTH)
				#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_lightDirSet)
				#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_normal)
				#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_layer0_color)
				#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_nativeNormal)
				half bumpLighting = dot(fs_lightDirSet.xyz, fs_normal);
				half plainLighting = dot(fs_lightDirSet.xyz, fs_nativeNormal.xyz);
				half adjustment = 1.0 + (bumpLighting - plainLighting);
				return half4(surfaceColor.rgb * diffuseLight * adjustment + specularLight, surfaceColor.a);
			#else
				return half4(surfaceColor.rgb * diffuseLight + specularLight, surfaceColor.a);
			#endif
		#elif defined(PRELIGHT_FX) 
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_lightDirSet)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_normal)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_layer0_color)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_nativeNormal)
			half bumpLighting = dot(fs_lightDirSet.xyz, fs_normal);
			half plainLighting = dot(fs_lightDirSet.xyz, fs_nativeNormal.xyz);
			half adjustment = 1.0 + (bumpLighting - plainLighting);
			return half4(surfaceColor.rgb * fs_layer0_color * adjustment + specularLight, surfaceColor.a);
		#elif (LIGHTING_STAGE == DISABLE)
			return surfaceColor;
		#elif (LIGHTING_STAGE == LIGHTING_GOOCH)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, fs_layer0_color)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, ambientColor)
			// Blend diffuse and ambient colours based on values calculated in diffuseStage()		
			//return ((surfaceColor * layer0_diffuse * diffuseLight.r) + (surfaceColor * ambientColor * diffuseLight.g));
			return half4( (surfaceColor.rgb * diffuseLight.r) + (ambientColor.rgb * diffuseLight.g) + specularLight, surfaceColor.a ) ;
		#else
			return half4(surfaceColor.rgb * diffuseLight + specularLight, surfaceColor.a);
		#endif

	#elif REFRACTION_STAGE == REFRACTION_DEFAULT

		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, refraction_kIndex)
		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, refraction_color)
		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, backBuffer_sampler)
		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, specular_params)
		#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_pos)
		#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_normal)
		#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_layer0_color)
		
		#if defined(LOD_SHADER)
		#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_lodFactor)
		const half lodFactor = varying_lodFactor;
		#else
		const half lodFactor = 1.0;
		#endif
		
		// Compute the refractive displacement.
		half2 disp = refraction_kIndex * fs_normal.xy * fs_layer0_color.a * lodFactor * refractMod;
		
		// This modulation factor reduces the problem of off-backbuffer fetches at the bottom of the screen.
		half modulation = 1.0 - pow(0.5 - fs_pos.y * 0.5, 15.0);
		disp.y *= modulation;
		
		// Perform the backbuffer look-up.
		half3 bbColor = tex2D(backBuffer_sampler, (fs_pos.xy * half2(0.5, -0.5) + 0.5) + disp).rgb;
		half4 refractedColor;
		
		// This is the final refraction alpha taking into account the material refraction alpha and the fresnel term.
		half refAlpha = min(1.0, refraction_color.a + (fresnel - specular_params.b));
		
		// This tints the backbuffer with the refraction colour, modulated by refraction alpha.
		refractedColor.rgb = refraction_color.rgb * lerp(bbColor, half3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0), refAlpha);
		
		// This diminishes the effect of the above tint according to vertex alpha and the refraction alpha.
		refractedColor.rgb = lerp(bbColor, refractedColor.rgb, fs_layer0_color.a * refAlpha * refractMod);
		
		// This applies lighting, surface diffuse texturing and specular effects to the above result.
		refractedColor.rgb = lerp(refractedColor.rgb, surfaceColor.rgb * diffuseLight, surfaceColor.a) + specularLight;

		refractedColor.a = 1.0;
		return refractedColor;
		
	#elif REFRACTION_STAGE == REFRACTION_WATER
	
		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, backBuffer_sampler)
		#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_uvSetGlass)
		#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_colorSet0)
		#if (PIXEL_SHADER_VERSION == 11)
			half4 bbColor = tex2D(backBuffer_sampler, varying_uvSetGlass.xy);
//			return half4(saturate(lerp(bbColor.rgb, surfaceColor.rgb, surfaceColor.a * 0.5)), 1.0);
			return half4(saturate(lerp(bbColor.rgb, surfaceColor.rgb, varying_colorSet0.a)), 1.0);
		#else
			half2 screenCoord = varying_uvSetGlass.xy / varying_uvSetGlass.z;
			half4 bbColor = tex2D(backBuffer_sampler, screenCoord);
			
			// real water effect HACK
			// hardwired values for bionicle hack on the water effect
//			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_worldIncident)
			half reflection = varying_colorSet0.a;// * saturate(1.0 - fs_worldIncident.y * 1.33);
			return half4(saturate(lerp(bbColor.rgb, surfaceColor.rgb, reflection)) + specularLight, 1.0);

		#endif

	#elif REFRACTION_STAGE == REFRACTION_GLASS

		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, backBuffer_sampler)
		
		#if (PIXEL_SHADER_VERSION == 11)

			#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_uvSetGlass)
			half3 bbColor = tex2D(backBuffer_sampler, varying_uvSetGlass.xy).rgb;
			half3 mix = surfaceColor.rgb * ((1.0 - surfaceColor.a) * bbColor + surfaceColor.a);
//			half3 mix = (1.0 - surfaceColor.a) * bbColor + surfaceColor.a;
			return half4(mix, 1.0);
			
		#else
		
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_pos)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_normal)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, view)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, fxAttributes)
			
			#if defined(LOD_SHADER)
			#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_lodFactor)
			const half lodFactor = varying_lodFactor;
			#else
			const half lodFactor = 1.0;
			#endif
		
			half3 eyeNormal = mul(fs_normal, (float3x3)view);
			half3 bbColor = tex2D(backBuffer_sampler, (fs_pos.xy * half2(0.5, -0.5) + 0.5) + eyeNormal.xy * fxAttributes.x * lodFactor).rgb;
			half3 mix = lerp(surfaceColor.rgb * bbColor, surfaceColor.rgb, surfaceColor.a);
			return half4(mix + specularLight, 1.0);
			
		#endif
		
	#endif
}

#if defined(ENVMAP_STAGE)
iNliNE half3 envmapStage(const in half3 diffuseLight, const half fresnel)
{
	#if ENVMAP_STAGE == DISABLE
		// envmap is disabled
		return half3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);

	#elif ENVMAP_STAGE == ENVMAP_CUBE
		// cubic style envmap
		#if (PIXEL_SHADER_VERSION == 11)
			// pixel shader 1.1
			#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_worldReflection)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, envmap_samplerCube)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, envmap_params)

			half4 envTexel = texCUBE(envmap_samplerCube, varying_worldReflection);
			#if (LIGHTING_STAGE == DISABLE)
				return envTexel.rgb * envmap_params.g;
			#else
				#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_colorSet0)
				#if REFRACTION_STAGE == REFRACTION_GLASS
					return envTexel.rgb * envmap_params.g * varying_colorSet0.rgb;
				#else
					//return envTexel.rgb * varying_colorSet0.rgb;
					//return 0.5 * envTexel.rgb * envmap_params.g * varying_colorSet0.rgb;
					return envTexel.rgb * envmap_params.g; // Fix from Indy
				#endif
			#endif
		#else
			// pixel shader 2.0 upwards
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, envmap_samplerCube)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, envmap_params)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_worldReflection)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_layer0_color)

			#if REFRACTION_STAGE != DISABLE
				half alphaFactor = fs_layer0_color.a;
			#else
				half alphaFactor = 1.0;
			#endif
			
			half4 envTexel = texCUBE(envmap_samplerCube, fs_worldReflection.rgb );
			
			half3 finalLightingFactor = (1.0 - envmap_params.r) + diffuseLight * envmap_params.r;
			#if defined(LEGO)
				#pragma nu2_use(uniform, lego_params)
				#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_normal)
				#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_incident)

				// Compute strength of the lego fresnel effect for given angle.
				half vdn = 1.0 - abs(dot(fs_incident, fs_normal));
				half legofresnel = lego_params.x + (lego_params.y - lego_params.x) * smoothstep(lego_params.z, lego_params.w, vdn);
				return envmap_params.g * envTexel.rgb * finalLightingFactor * alphaFactor * legofresnel;
			#else
				// Apply alpha simulated HDR
				envTexel *= lerp( envTexel.a*envmap_params.b, 1, fresnel);
				return envmap_params.g * envTexel.rgb * finalLightingFactor * alphaFactor;
			#endif
		#endif
		
	#elif ENVMAP_STAGE == PS2_SHINEMAP
		// ps2 shinemap style envmap
		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, ps2_shinemap_sampler)
		#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_shineMapCoord)
		half4 envTexel = tex2D(ps2_shinemap_sampler, varying_shineMapCoord);
		#if (PIXEL_SHADER_VERSION == 11)
			#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_colorSet0)
			return envTexel.rgb * 0.5 * varying_colorSet0.rgb;
		#else
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, specular_params)
			return envTexel.rgb * specular_params.g * diffuseLight;
		#endif
		
	#elif ENVMAP_STAGE == ENVMAP_SPHERE
		// sphere style envmap
		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, ps2_shinemap_sampler)
		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, envmap_params)
		#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_shineMapCoord)
		half4 envTexel = tex2D(ps2_shinemap_sampler, varying_shineMapCoord);
		return envTexel.rgb * envmap_params.g * diffuseLight * 2.0;
	#endif
}

//__________________________________________________________________________________________________
#endif

#if defined(FOG_STAGE)

void fogStage()
{
	#if FOG_STAGE == DISABLE
	#else
		#if FOG_STAGE == FOG_LINEAR
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, fs_projection_params)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, fog_params)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_pos)
			half zFragEye = fs_projection_params.x / (1 - fs_pos.z*fs_projection_params.w);
			half falloff = saturate((fog_params.x - zFragEye) / fog_params.z);
		#elif FOG_STAGE == FOG_EXPONENTIAL
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, fs_projection_params)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, fog_params)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_pos)
			// TODO make xFragEye a shared resource
			float zFragEye = fs_projection_params.x / (1 - fs_pos.z*fs_projection_params.w);
			half falloff = 1.0 / exp(zFragEye * fog_params.w);
		#elif FOG_STAGE == FOG_EXPONENTIAL2
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, fs_projection_params)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, fog_params)
			#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_pos)
			half zFragEye = fs_projection_params.x / (1 - fs_pos.z*fs_projection_params.w);
			half dd = zFragEye* fog_params.w;
			half falloff = 1.0 / exp(dd*dd);
		#elif FOG_STAGE == FOG_VERTEX_LINEAR || FOG_STAGE == FOG_VERTEX_EXPONENTIAL || FOG_STAGE == FOG_VERTEX_EXPONENTIAL2 || FOG_STAGE == FOG_VERTEX_CLAMP_EXPONENTIAL2
			#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_fogFactor)
			half falloff = varying_fogFactor;
		#elif FOG_STAGE == FOG_VERTEX_CLAMP_EXPONENTIAL2_PS3
			#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_ps3FogParams)
			half falloff = varying_ps3FogParams.y;
		#endif
		
		#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_fog_color)
		fout.color[0].rgb = lerp(fs_fog_color.rgb, fout.color[0].rgb, falloff);

	#endif
}

#if defined(REFRACTION_STAGE) && REFRACTION_STAGE == REFRACTION_WATER
void refractionWater()
{
	#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_uvSetGlass)
	#pragma nu2_use(attribute, colorSet0)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, fxAttributes)
	#pragma nu2_use(vs_local, vs_waterCoef)
	
	#if (VERTEX_SHADER_VERSION == 11)
	
		// Compute backbuffer uv for shader 1.1
		half w2 = max(0.0001, abs(varying_position.w));
		varying_uvSetGlass.xy = (varying_position.xy + 0.02 * vin.colorSet0.a * fxAttributes.w * vs_waterCoef.xy) / w2;
		varying_uvSetGlass.y = -varying_uvSetGlass.y;
		varying_uvSetGlass.xy = saturate((varying_uvSetGlass.xy * 0.5) + 0.5);
		varying_uvSetGlass.z = 1.0;
		
	#else
	
		#if defined(LOD_SHADER)
		#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_lodFactor)
		const half lodFactor = varying_lodFactor;
		#else
		const half lodFactor = 1.0;
		#endif
		
		// Compute backbuffer uv for shader 2.0+
		varying_uvSetGlass.xy = varying_position.xy + vin.colorSet0.a * fxAttributes.w * vs_waterCoef.xy * lodFactor;
		varying_uvSetGlass = half3(varying_uvSetGlass.x, -varying_uvSetGlass.y, varying_position.w);
		varying_uvSetGlass.xy = 0.5 * (varying_uvSetGlass.xy + varying_uvSetGlass.zz);
				
	#endif
}

#if defined(VERTEX_GROUP)
void vertexGroupCompute()
{
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, offsetTable)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, vertexGroupStates)
	#pragma nu2_use(attribute, normal)
	#pragma nu2_use(vs_local, vs_randomSeed)
	
	// dynamic offset geometry
	// the vertex group is encoded within normal.w
	// resolve the vertex group. it is normal.w * 255, but then
	// the vertex group states are packed by 4 in the half4 vertexGroupStates[20] array.
	
	half mgroup, ngroup;

	#if defined(PACKED_NORMAL)	
		#if (VERTEX_SHADER_VERSION == 11)
		mgroup = D3DCOLORtoUBYTE4(vin.normal).w;	// Was packed as D3DCOLOR
		#else
		mgroup = vin.normal.w * 255.0;
		#endif
	#else
	mgroup = vin.normal.w * 127.0;
	// NOTE THAT if there is more than 128 vertex group this shader code will break!
	// If the vertex group value is greater than 127 (vin.normal.w < 0), it should be
	// correctly computed using: 255.0 + vin.normal.w * 127.0
	#endif
	
	mgroup = round(mgroup);
	ngroup = modf(mgroup/4.0, mgroup);

	int vertexGroupState;
	if (ngroup >= 0.5 - 0.1)
	{
		if (ngroup >= 0.75 - 0.1)
			vertexGroupState = (int)vertexGroupStates[mgroup].a;
		else
			vertexGroupState = (int)vertexGroupStates[mgroup].b;
	}
	else
	{
		if (ngroup >= 0.25 - 0.1)
			vertexGroupState = (int)vertexGroupStates[mgroup].g;
		else
			vertexGroupState = (int)vertexGroupStates[mgroup].r;
	}

	if (vertexGroupState == 0.0)
		varying_position.z -= 100000.0; // force the vertex to be clipped away
	else
	{
		half2 stateOffset = offsetTable[vertexGroupState].xy;
		
		#if defined(USE_vs_uvSet0)
			vs_uvSet0 += stateOffset;
		#endif
		#if defined(USE_vs_uvSet1)
			vs_uvSet1 += stateOffset;
		#endif
		#if defined(USE_vs_uvSet2)
			vs_uvSet2 += stateOffset;
		#endif
		#if defined(USE_vs_uvSet3)
			vs_uvSet3 += stateOffset;
		#endif
	}
}

#endif

#if defined(USE_fs_worldReflection)

// world reflection are always computed in the pixel shader by passing the normal
// from the vertex shader. This is to ease vertex shader workload (we are vertex bound in transformers)
iNliNE half3 func_fs_computeWorldReflection()
{
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, view)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, fs_viewInverseTranspose)
	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_normal)
	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_incident)
	
	// incident and reflection vectors are not normalized because
	// the worldReflection is going to be used to sample a cube map only.
	half3 reflection = reflect(fs_incident, fs_normal);
	return -mul((float3x3)fs_viewInverseTranspose, reflection);
}

#elif FUNC_fs_computeNormal == FROM_SURFACE_NORMAL
half3 func_fs_computeNormal()
{
	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_nativeNormal)
	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_normal)
	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_tangent)
	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_bitangent)
	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_surfaceNormal)

	// [tangent, bitangent, normal] create a matrix that project from
	// tangent space to world space. We take the normal from the normal map, and project it
	// to world space.
	// No need to normalise as we're just projecting 
	return normalize(fs_surfaceNormal.x * fs_tangent + fs_surfaceNormal.y * fs_bitangent + fs_surfaceNormal.z * fs_nativeNormal.xyz);
}

#elif FUNC_fs_computeNormal == FROM_DETAIL_SURFACE_NORMAL
half3 func_fs_computeNormal()
{
	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_nativeNormal)
	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_normal)
	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_tangent)
	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_bitangent)
	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_surfaceNormal)
	#pragma nu2_use(varying, * DETAIL_SURFACE_UVSET)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, detailSurface_sampler)
	
	half3 normal = normalize(
		fs_surfaceNormal.x * fs_tangent
		+ fs_surfaceNormal.y * fs_bitangent
		+ fs_surfaceNormal.z * fs_nativeNormal.xyz);

	half3 detailNormal = tex2D(detailSurface_sampler, DETAIL_SURFACE_UVSET).rgb * 2.0 - 1.0;
	return normalize(
		detailNormal.x * fs_tangent
		+ detailNormal.y * fs_bitangent
		+ detailNormal.z * normal);
}

#elif FUNC_fs_computeNormal == FROM_VTF_NORMAL

{

	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_bitangent)
	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_vtfNormal)
	#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_waterAmplitude)

	return lerp(fs_nativeNormal.xyz, normalize(
		fs_vtfNormal.x * fs_tangent
		+ fs_vtfNormal.y * fs_bitangent
		+ fs_vtfNormal.z * fs_nativeNormal.xyz), varying_waterAmplitude);

{

	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_bitangent)
	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_surfaceNormal)
	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_vtfNormal)
	#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_waterAmplitude)
	
	half3 sNormal = fs_surfaceNormal.x * fs_tangent + fs_surfaceNormal.y * fs_bitangent + fs_surfaceNormal.z * fs_nativeNormal.xyz;
	half3 vNormal = fs_vtfNormal.x     * fs_tangent + fs_vtfNormal.y     * fs_bitangent + fs_vtfNormal.z     * fs_nativeNormal.xyz;
	
	vNormal = lerp(fs_nativeNormal.xyz, vNormal, varying_waterAmplitude);
	return normalize(sNormal + vNormal);

// default rule for fs_surfaceNormal

#if !defined(FUNC_fs_computeSurfaceNormal)
#elif FUNC_fs_computeSurfaceNormal == SURFACE_NORMAL_MAP
iNliNE half4 func_fs_computeSurfaceNormal()
{
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, surface_sampler)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, surface_params)
	#pragma nu2_use(varying, * SURFACE_UVSET)

	//	Sample the normal map
	#if (PIXEL_SHADER_VERSION == 11)
		#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_uvSetN)
		#if defined(SWIZZLE_NORMAL_MAPS)
			half4 surfaceNormal = tex2D(surface_sampler, varying_uvSetN).agbr * 2 - 1;
		#else
			half4 surfaceNormal = tex2D(surface_sampler, varying_uvSetN) - 0.5;
		#endif
	
	#else
		#if defined(SWIZZLE_NORMAL_MAPS)
			half4 surfaceNormal = tex2D(surface_sampler, SURFACE_UVSET).agbr * 2.0 - 1.0;
		#else
			half4 surfaceNormal = tex2D(surface_sampler, SURFACE_UVSET) * 2.0 - 1.0;
		#endif

		#if defined(TWO_COMPONENT_NORMAL_MAPS)
		surfaceNormal.z = sqrt(1.0 - (surfaceNormal.x*surfaceNormal.x + surfaceNormal.y*surfaceNormal.y));
		#endif
		surfaceNormal.xy *= surface_params.r;
		
		#if defined(LOD_SHADER)
		#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_lodFactor)
		surfaceNormal.xy *= varying_lodFactor;
		#endif
	
	#endif
	
	#if (SURFACE_TYPE2 == SURFACE_NORMAL_MAP)
		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, surface2_sampler)
		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, surface_params2)
		#pragma nu2_use(varying, * LAYER1_UVSET)
		#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_blend2)

		#if defined(SWIZZLE_NORMAL_MAPS)
			half4 surfaceNormal2 = tex2D(surface2_sampler, LAYER1_UVSET).agbr * 2.0 - 1.0;
		#else
			half4 surfaceNormal2 = tex2D(surface2_sampler, LAYER1_UVSET) * 2.0 - 1.0;
		#endif
		
		#if defined(TWO_COMPONENT_NORMAL_MAPS)
		surfaceNormal2.z = sqrt(1.0 - (surfaceNormal2.x*surfaceNormal2.x + surfaceNormal2.y*surfaceNormal2.y));
		#endif
		surfaceNormal2.xy *= surface_params2.r;

		#if defined(LOD_SHADER)
		#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_lodFactor)
		surfaceNormal2.xy *= varying_lodFactor;
		#endif
		
		surfaceNormal.xyz = normalize(lerp(surfaceNormal.xyz, surfaceNormal2.xyz, fs_blend2).xyz);
	#else
		#if (PIXEL_SHADER_VERSION != 11)
			surfaceNormal.xyz = normalize(surfaceNormal.xyz);
		#endif
	#endif

	return surfaceNormal;
}

#elif FUNC_fs_computeSurfaceNormal == SURFACE_PARALLAX_MAP
iNliNE half4 func_fs_computeSurfaceNormal()
{
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, surface_sampler)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, surface_params)
	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_surfaceIncident)
	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_stOffset)
	#pragma nu2_use(varying, * SURFACE_UVSET)

	// Calculate parallax effect.
	#if defined(SWIZZLE_PARALLAX_MAPS)
		half h0 = tex2D(surface_sampler, SURFACE_UVSET).r;
	#else
		half h0 = tex2D(surface_sampler, SURFACE_UVSET).a;
	#endif


	// we take the opposite of offset.y because the y axis in the texture goes down,
	// whereas our vectors (e.g. fs_surfaceIncident) are defined in a coordinate system where
	// y axis goes up intituively
	half2 incident = half2(fs_surfaceIncident.x,-fs_surfaceIncident.y);
	
	half hsb = 2.0 * (h0 - 0.5) + surface_params.a;
    fs_stOffset = hsb * surface_params.r * surface_params.b * incident.xy;
  
	#if defined(SWIZZLE_PARALLAX_MAPS)
		half4 surfaceNormal =  tex2D(surface_sampler, SURFACE_UVSET + fs_stOffset).agbr * 2.0 - 1.0;
	#else
		half4 surfaceNormal =  tex2D(surface_sampler, SURFACE_UVSET + fs_stOffset) * 2.0 - 1.0;
	#endif

	surfaceNormal.xy *= surface_params.r;
	
	#if defined(LOD_SHADER)
	#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_lodFactor)
	surfaceNormal.xy *= varying_lodFactor;
	#endif
	
	#if (SURFACE_TYPE2 == SURFACE_PARALLAX_MAP)
		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, surface2_sampler)
		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, surface_params2)
		#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_surfaceIncident2)
		#pragma nu2_use(varying, * LAYER1_UVSET)
		#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_blend2)
		
		// Calculate parallax effect.
		#if defined(SWIZZLE_PARALLAX_MAPS)
			half h02 = tex2D(surface2_sampler, LAYER1_UVSET).r;
		#else
			half h02 = tex2D(surface2_sampler, LAYER1_UVSET).a;
		#endif

		half hsb2 = 2.0 * (h02 - 0.5) + surface_params.a;
		half2 stOffset2 = hsb2 * surface_params2.r * surface_params.b * incident.xy;
		
		#if defined(SWIZZLE_PARALLAX_MAPS)
			half4 surfaceNormal2 =  tex2D(surface2_sampler, LAYER1_UVSET + stOffset2).agbr * 2.0 - 1.0;
		#else
			half4 surfaceNormal2 =  tex2D(surface2_sampler, LAYER1_UVSET + stOffset2) * 2.0 - 1.0;
		#endif
		surfaceNormal2.xy *= surface_params2.r;
		
		#if defined(LOD_SHADER)
		#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_lodFactor)
		surfaceNormal2.xy *= varying_lodFactor;
		#endif

		fs_stOffset = lerp(fs_stOffset, stOffset2, fs_blend2);
		
		surfaceNormal.xyz = normalize(lerp(surfaceNormal.xyz, surfaceNormal2.xyz, fs_blend2).xyz);
	#else
		surfaceNormal.xyz = normalize(surfaceNormal.xyz);
	#endif
	
	return surfaceNormal;
}

#if defined(FRACTAL)

half gradperm(half x, half3 p)
{
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, permgrad_sampler)
	half3 pg = tex2D(permgrad_sampler, half2(x, 0.5)).xyz * 2.0 - 1.0;
	return dot(pg, p);
}

half inoise(half3 p)
{
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, perm_sampler)

	// Find the unit cube that contains the given point.
	half3 floorP = floor(p);

	// Find relative x,y,z of point in the cube.
	p -= floorP;

	// Compute fade curves for each of x,y,z.
	half3 f = p * p * p * (p * (p * 6.0 - 15.0) + 10.0);

	half3 modP = modf(floorP / 256.0f, floorP);
	half one = 1.0 / 256.0;

	// Hash the coordinates of the 8 cube corners.
	half4 AA = tex2D(perm_sampler, modP.xy) + modP.z;

	// Add the blended results from the 8 corners of the cube.
	return lerp(lerp(lerp(gradperm(AA.x,       p),                           gradperm(AA.z,       p + half3(-1.0,  0.0,  0.0)), f.x),
				     lerp(gradperm(AA.y,       p + half3( 0.0, -1.0,  0.0)), gradperm(AA.w,       p + half3(-1.0, -1.0,  0.0)), f.x), f.y),
			    lerp(lerp(gradperm(AA.x + one, p + half3( 0.0,  0.0, -1.0)), gradperm(AA.z + one, p + half3(-1.0,  0.0, -1.0)), f.x),
				     lerp(gradperm(AA.y + one, p + half3( 0.0, -1.0, -1.0)), gradperm(AA.w + one, p + half3(-1.0, -1.0, -1.0)), f.x), f.y), f.z);
}

half fBm(half3 p, half baseFrequency, half lacunarity, half gain)
{
	half sum = 0.0;

	half frequency = baseFrequency;
	half amplitude = 0.5;
	
	// A for loop! Fractals are only used on shader 3.0 and above.
	for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
	{
		// Accumulate 4 noise octaves.
		sum += inoise(p * frequency) * amplitude;
		frequency *= lacunarity;
		amplitude *= gain;
	}

	return sum;
}

half3 fBmGradient(half3 p, half baseFrequency, half lacunarity, half gain)
{
	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_fbm0)
	half eps = 0.1 / baseFrequency;
	fs_fbm0 = fBm(p,                        baseFrequency, lacunarity, gain);
	half fx = fBm(p + half3(eps, 0.0, 0.0), baseFrequency, lacunarity, gain);
	half fy = fBm(p + half3(0.0, eps, 0.0), baseFrequency, lacunarity, gain);
	half fz = fBm(p + half3(0.0, 0.0, eps), baseFrequency, lacunarity, gain);
	return half3(fx - fs_fbm0, fy - fs_fbm0, fz - fs_fbm0) / eps;
}

void func_fs_fractalBump()
{
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, surface_params2)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, fractal_params)
	#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_modelPosition)
	#pragma nu2_use(fs_local, fs_normal)
	fs_normal = fs_normal + surface_params2.g * fBmGradient(varying_modelPosition, fractal_params.r, fractal_params.g, fractal_params.b);
	fs_normal = normalize(fs_normal);
}

#if defined(USE_varying_colorSet0)
iNliNE void pipeColorSet0()
{
	#pragma nu2_use(attribute, colorSet0)
	#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_colorSet0)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, kTint)
	
	#if (FUNC_pipePosition == VERTEX_TRANSFORM_WATER)
		// We boost water alpha here, as a shader 1.1 compiler bug messes up the boost in the pixel shader.
		vin.colorSet0.a *= 1.5;
	#endif

	#if (VERTEX_SHADER_VERSION == 11)
		
		#if (LIGHTING_STAGE != DISABLE)

			// Compute and apply the diffuse lighting in the vertex shader.
			#pragma nu2_use(vs_local, vs_normal)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, ambientColor)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, vs_sceneAmbientColor)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, incandescentGlow)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, vs_lightPosition0)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, vs_lightPosition1)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, vs_lightPosition2)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, vs_lightColor0)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, vs_lightColor1)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, vs_lightColor2)
			#pragma nu2_use(uniform, layer_kOpacities)

			half3 diffuseLight = ambientColor.rgb + vs_sceneAmbientColor.rgb;
			#if LIGHTING_LIGHTS_COUNT > 0
			diffuseLight += max(0, dot(vs_lightPosition0.xyz, vs_normal)) * vs_lightColor0.rgb * vs_lightPosition0.w;
			#endif
			#if LIGHTING_LIGHTS_COUNT > 1
			diffuseLight += max(0, dot(vs_lightPosition1.xyz, vs_normal)) * vs_lightColor1.rgb * vs_lightPosition1.w;
			#endif
			#if LIGHTING_LIGHTS_COUNT > 2
			diffuseLight += max(0, dot(vs_lightPosition2.xyz, vs_normal)) * vs_lightColor2.rgb * vs_lightPosition2.w;
			#endif

			diffuseLight = lerp(diffuseLight, half3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0), incandescentGlow.rgb);
			
			#if defined(LAYER0_DIFFUSEENABLE) || (REFRACTION_STAGE == REFRACTION_GLASS) || (REFRACTION_STAGE == REFRACTION_WATER)
				#pragma nu2_use(uniform, layer0_diffuse)
				varying_colorSet0 = saturate(layer0_diffuse * vin.colorSet0 * COLOR_FACTOR * half4(diffuseLight, 1.0));
			#else
				varying_colorSet0 = saturate(vin.colorSet0 * COLOR_FACTOR * half4(diffuseLight, 1.0));
				varying_colorSet0.a *= layer_kOpacities.r;
			#endif
			
			// Live-lit vertex shader 1.1 result
			//varying_colorSet0 = saturate(COLOR_FACTOR * varying_colorSet0 * kTint);
			varying_colorSet0 = saturate(varying_colorSet0 * kTint);
			
		#else
		
			// Prelit vertex shader 1.1 result
			varying_colorSet0 = saturate(COLOR_FACTOR * vin.colorSet0 * kTint);

		#endif
	#else

		// Vertex shader 2.0+ result
		varying_colorSet0 = saturate(vin.colorSet0 * kTint);

	#endif
}

#if defined(USE_computeVertexSkin)
iNliNE half4 computeVertexSkin(const in float4 pos,
                               const in float4x4 skinMatrix0,
                               const in float4x4 skinMatrix1,
                               const in float4x4 skinMatrix2,
                               const in half w0,
                               const in half w1,
                               const in half w2)
{
	// rem: skinMatrix must be matrices that project directly from object space
	// to world space
	float4 t0 = mul(pos, skinMatrix0);
	float4 t1 = mul(pos, skinMatrix1);
	float4 t2 = mul(pos, skinMatrix2);
	return t0*w0 + t1*w1 + t2*w2;
}

//__________________________________________________________________________________________________
#endif

#if defined(USE_computeWind)
iNliNE half4 computeWind(const in float4 pos)
{
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, wind_sampler)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, wind_params)

	half4 wind = 0.0;
	half wind_size = 256.0;
	
	// sample wind texture
	half4 t = half4(pos.xz+float2(wind_params.x, wind_params.x), 0.0f, 0.0f);
	half4 fn = tex2Dlod(wind_sampler, t);
	half4 tx, ty;
	ty = frac(fn);
	tx = (fn-ty)/128.0 - 1.0;
	ty = ty*2.0 - 1.0;

	// bilinear filtering
	half2 f = frac(t.xy*wind_size);
	half2 tA = lerp(float2(tx.x, ty.x), float2(tx.y, ty.y), f.x);
	half2 tB = lerp(float2(tx.z, ty.z), float2(tx.w, ty.w), f.x);
	wind.xz = lerp(tA, tB, f.y);
	wind.w = length(wind.xz);
	
	return wind;
}

//__________________________________________________________________________________________________
#endif

#if defined(USE_computeVertexWindOffset)
iNliNE float4 computeVertexWindOffset()
{
	#define USE_computeWind
	#pragma nu2_use(vs_local, vs_plantParams)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, world)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, wind_params)

	float4 plant_position = {world._m30+vs_plantParams.x, 0.0f, world._m32+vs_plantParams.y, 0.0f};
	float4 wind_map = 0.0;
	float4 offset = 0.0;
	float4 random_tangent = 0.0;
	float4 random_idle = {vs_plantParams.x, 0.0, vs_plantParams.y, 0.0};
	float fbend = vs_plantParams.z;
	float ftangent = vs_plantParams.w;

	// sample wind
	float4 worldpos = (mul(plant_position, world)+wind_params.y*0.5)/wind_params.y;
	wind_map = computeWind(worldpos);

	// motion regarding the wind
	offset.xz = wind_map.xz * fbend;
	offset.y = length(offset.xz)*(-0.25);
	offset.xz -= offset.xz*0.2;

	random_tangent.xz = cross(half3(wind_map.x, 0.0, wind_map.z), half3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0)) * wind_params.w*wind_map.w * ftangent * fbend;
	random_tangent.y = 0.0;

	// random motion
	random_idle = random_idle * fbend * wind_params.z;

	return (offset+random_idle+random_tangent);
}
#endif

#if defined(USE_computeVertexWindOffset2)
iNliNE half4 computeVertexWindOffset2()
{
	#define USE_computeWind
	#pragma nu2_use(vs_local, vs_plantParams)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, world)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, wind_params)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, wind_sampler)

	float4 plant_position = {world._m30+vs_plantParams.x, 0.0f, world._m32+vs_plantParams.y, 0.0f};
	float4 wind_map = 0.0;
	float4 offset = 0.0;
	half4 random = 0.0;
	half4 direction = {vs_plantParams.x*0.2, 0.0, vs_plantParams.y*0.2, 0.0};
	half fbend = vs_plantParams.z*2.0-1.0;
	half ftangent = vs_plantParams.w;

	// sample wind
	float4 worldpos = (mul(plant_position, world)+wind_params.y*0.5)/wind_params.y;
	wind_map = computeWind(worldpos);

	// motion regarding the wind
	offset.xz = direction.xz * wind_map.w * ftangent * cross(half3(direction.x, 0.0, direction.z), half3(wind_map.x, 0.0, wind_map.z)).y*dot(direction.xz, wind_map.xz);
	offset.y = wind_map.w * fbend;

	random.xz = direction.xz * wind_params.w * wind_map.w * ftangent * 0.25;
	random.y = wind_params.z * fbend * 0.25;

	return offset+random;
}

//__________________________________________________________________________________________________
#endif

#if defined(USE_computeVertexWindOffsetTree)
iNliNE float4 computeVertexWindOffsetTree()
{
	#define USE_computeWind
	#pragma nu2_use(vs_local, vs_plantParams)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, wind_params)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, world)

	float4 plant_position = {world._m30+vs_plantParams.x, 0.0f, world._m32+vs_plantParams.y, 0.0f};
	float4 wind_map = 0.0;
	float4 offset = 0.0;

	// sample wind
	float4 worldpos = (mul(plant_position, world)+wind_params.y*0.5)/wind_params.y;
	wind_map = computeWind(worldpos);
	
	// motion regarding the wind
	offset.xz = wind_map.xz * wind_map.w * fbend;

	return offset;
}

#elif FUNC_pipePosition == VERTEX_TRANSFORM_BLEND_ANIM_SKINNING_360
iNliNE void func_pipePosition()

	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, skinMatrix)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, blendShapesCount)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, blendShapes)
	#pragma nu2_use(attribute, position)
	#pragma nu2_use(attribute, blendIndices0)
	#pragma nu2_use(attribute, blendWeight0)
	#pragma nu2_use(attribute, index)
	#pragma nu2_use(vs_local, vs_skinPosition)
	#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_position)
	
	// blendShapes[i].x <=> index offset in the vertex stream
	// blendShapes[i].y <=> blend shape weight
	
	half3 vTotalOffset = 0.0;
	for (int i = 0; i < MAX_BLEND_SHAPES; i++)

			};
			vTotalOffset += vOffset.xyz * blendShapes[i].y;

	// blended anim skinning
	float4 blendedVertex = vin.position + half4(vTotalOffset, 0.0);
	vs_skinPosition = computeVertexSkin(
		blendedVertex,
		skinMatrix[int(vin.blendIndices0.x)],
		skinMatrix[int(vin.blendIndices0.y)],

		1.0 - vin.blendWeight0.x - vin.blendWeight0.y
	);

#elif FUNC_pipePosition == VERTEX_FETCH_DISPLACEMENT
iNliNE void func_pipePosition()
{
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, world)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, viewProj)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, vertexFetch_sampler)
	#pragma nu2_use(uniform, vtf_kHeight)
	#pragma nu2_use(attribute, position)
	#pragma nu2_use(vs_local, *VERTEX_FETCH_UVSET)
	#pragma nu2_use(vs_local, vs_skinPosition)
	#pragma nu2_use(vs_local, vs_waterAmplitude)
	#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_position)

	// Expects:
	//   G channel shifted right 1 texel
	//   B channel shifted down 1 texel
	//   A channel shifted right 1 texel and down 1 texel, i.e.
	//
	//   R G  =  Height(u, v    )  Height(u - 1, v    )
	//	 B A  =  Height(u, v - 1)  Height(u - 1, v - 1)

	vs_skinPosition = mul(vin.position, world);

	half textureSize = 256.0f;
	half nextTexel = -1.0 / textureSize;
	half2 f2 = frac(VERTEX_FETCH_UVSET * textureSize);
	half4 uv4 = half4(VERTEX_FETCH_UVSET, 0.0, 0.0);

	half4 t4 = tex2Dlod(vertexFetch_sampler, uv4);

	// This shouldn't be required, but the alpha read above doesn't seem to come out correctly.
	t4.a = tex2Dlod(vertexFetch_sampler, uv4 + half4(nextTexel, nextTexel, 0.0, 0.0)).r;

	half2 t2 = lerp(t4.ga, t4.rb, f2.x);    // Interpolate top and bottom of texel in x
	half offset = lerp(t2.y, t2.x, f2.y);   // Interpolate last interpolation result in y
	
	#pragma nu2_use(attribute, normal)
	#if defined(PACKED_NORMAL)
		#if (VERTEX_SHADER_VERSION == 11)
			half4 vNormal = vin.normal.zyxw;	// was packed as D3DCOLOR
		#else
			half4 vNormal = vin.normal;
		#endif
	
		half3 worldNormal = normalize(mul(vNormal.xyz * 2.0 - 1.0, (float3x3)world));
	#else
		half3 worldNormal = normalize(mul(vin.normal.xyz, (float3x3)world));
	#endif
	vs_skinPosition.xyz += worldNormal * ((offset - 0.5) * vtf_kHeight * vs_waterAmplitude);
	
//	vs_skinPosition.y += (offset - 0.5) * vtf_kHeight * vs_waterAmplitude;
//	vs_skinPosition.y += offset * vtf_kHeight * vin.colorSet0.a;
	varying_position = mul(vs_skinPosition, viewProj);
}

	#pragma nu2_use(varying, varying_uvSetGlass)
	#pragma nu2_use(vs_local, vs_skinPosition)
	#pragma nu2_use(vs_local, vs_normal)
	
	// skinning

	// rem: skinMatrix must be matrices that project directly from object space
	// to world space
	vs_skinPosition = computeVertexSkin(
		vin.position,
		skinMatrix[int(vin.blendIndices0.x)],
		skinMatrix[int(vin.blendIndices0.y)],
		skinMatrix[int(vin.blendIndices0.z)],
		vin.blendWeight0.x,
		vin.blendWeight0.y,
		1.0 - vin.blendWeight0.x - vin.blendWeight0.y
	);

	#define USE_projectToClipSpace_forSkin
	varying_position = projectToClipSpace_forSkin(vs_skinPosition);

	#if (VERTEX_SHADER_VERSION == 11)
		#pragma nu2_use(uniform, viewProj)
		// Compute backbuffer uv for shader 1.1
		half3 screenNormal = mul(vs_normal, viewProj);
		half w2 = max(0.0001, abs(varying_position.w));
		varying_uvSetGlass.xy = varying_position.xy / w2;
		varying_uvSetGlass.y = -varying_uvSetGlass.y;
		varying_uvSetGlass.xy += screenNormal.xy * fxAttributes.x;
		varying_uvSetGlass.xy = saturate((varying_uvSetGlass.xy * 0.5) + 0.5);
	#endif
}
